attributes.description:
Sets the background color of the webview. When transparent, only the webview is visible. When filled with a color, the webview appears with a colored background.
CSS variable: --wm-webview-background-color

Controls the padding around the webview content. The first value sets vertical padding (top/bottom) and the second value sets horizontal padding (left/right).
CSS variable: --wm-webview-padding
